And now, the part I really wanted to say

❦

Dear Maaaamaaaa,

Happy 29th Birthday, my love. ♡

This is the fifth birthday of yours that we're celebrating together, and somehow, even after all this time, I still miss being close to you.

I wish I could be there beside you today — to celebrate you, see your smile, and make this day a little more special in person.

But until that day comes, I hope you know this:

My love for you has never become less.

It hasn't stayed exactly the same either.

It has only grown.

With every conversation.
With every memory.
With every year we've somehow made it through together.

I still love you. And I hope next year, instead of celebrating from far away, we get to celebrate your birthday together.

Happy Birthday, my Maaaamaaaa. ♡

And if you ever wonder whether my love for you has changed...

Yes, it has.

It has grown.

❦

Five birthdays

And still counting.

I hope the next one isn't celebrated from far away.

I hope I'm beside you.

Happy Birthday, Maaaamaaaa. ♡
